scoring_justification: NEB full recomputation is infeasible in checker sandbox; compare reported activation energies to paper-reported gold within tolerance.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold value for Li migration barrier in VS2 supercell (interlayer ~5.736 Å)
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 1 and text: supercell barrier ~0.74–0.75 eV; representative value 0.75 eV
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper Table 1 and corresponding discussion; the rate-determining barrier is 0.75 eV (O–T path).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Directly matches the paper's reported barrier range and is used for tolerance comparison.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold value for Li migration barrier on VS2 monolayer (expanded interlayer limit)
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 1 and text: rate-determining activation energy for Li diffusion on monolayer is 0.23 eV
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper Table 1 (H–T' and H–T barriers both 0.23 eV).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Directly matches the paper's reported barrier and is used for tolerance comparison.

schema.description: Key-value pairs of the migration energy barrier in eV.
